name: loomground-ingest
description: Drive the network-free Loomground ingest plane: dispatch a post-acquisition artifact to the registered ingester, lower it to a dimensioned subgraph with provenance and quarantine semantics, dry-run by default, and write only through the host-injected, versioned Versum sink.

interface.shortDescription: Multimodal artifacts into dimensioned versum subgraphs
interface.longDescription: The network-free ingest plane of the Loomground designer workflow: receive host-acquired artifact content, dispatch to the registered ingester, and lower it to a provenance-stamped dimensioned subgraph headed for the versum mental model - dry-run by default, confirmation required and enforced by the host (not this library), quarantine respected.
